cause_quote: The new recovery guard passed `buildModelCatalogRef(agentMeta.provider, agentMeta.model)` to `areRuntimeModelRefsEquivalent`, blocking fallback clearance when the finalizer reported a different model from the admitted session model.
user_saw: A fallback notice could remain active after the selected model had successfully resumed.
summary: The fix checks the admitted session model when deciding whether a successful turn clears a fallback notice.
reasoning: The parent of #169773 already computed fallback recovery from the admitted session model and cleared the saved notice, and its existing tests expected a recovery notice in direct chats. I checked the introducing diff and confirmed that its new guard canceled the existing state transition when the response model differed from the selected model, which can happen when a separate finalizer writes the reply.
